features.name: near_patch
features.label: near the patch
features.definition: patch distance <= 100 px

features.name: at_modal_location
features.label: at the most occupied location
features.definition: within 100 px of the most occupied 25-px cell of the discovery part (487.5, 162.5)

features.name: open_arena
features.label: elsewhere in the arena
features.definition: neither near the patch nor at the most occupied location

features.name: stationary
features.label: stationary
features.definition: speed < 5 px/s

features.name: moving
features.label: moving
features.definition: speed >= 20 px/s

features.name: fast
features.label: fast locomotion
features.definition: speed >= 100 px/s

features.name: accelerating
features.label: accelerating
features.definition: acceleration >= 200 px/s^2

features.name: decelerating
features.label: decelerating
features.definition: acceleration <= -200 px/s^2

features.name: heading_right
features.label: moving right (+x)
features.definition: movement direction within 45 deg of +x
features.population: windows with valid tracking and speed >= 20 px/s

features.name: heading_down
features.label: moving down (+y)
features.definition: movement direction within 45 deg of +y
features.population: windows with valid tracking and speed >= 20 px/s

features.name: heading_left
features.label: moving left (-x)
features.definition: movement direction within 45 deg of -x
features.population: windows with valid tracking and speed >= 20 px/s

features.name: heading_up
features.label: moving up (-y)
features.definition: movement direction within 45 deg of -y
features.population: windows with valid tracking and speed >= 20 px/s

features.name: toward_patch
features.label: moving toward the patch
features.definition: movement direction within 45 deg of the direction to the patch
features.population: windows with valid tracking and speed >= 20 px/s

features.name: away_from_patch
features.label: moving away from the patch
features.definition: movement direction at least 135 deg from the direction to the patch
features.population: windows with valid tracking and speed >= 20 px/s

features.name: small_area
features.label: small body area
features.definition: area <= lowest-quintile edge of the discovery part (470.5 px^2)

features.name: large_area
features.label: large body area
features.definition: area >= highest-quintile edge of the discovery part (574.5 px^2)

features.name: wheel_active
features.label: wheel running
features.definition: wheel speed > 0.05 turns/s

features.name: wheel_fast
features.label: fast wheel running
features.definition: wheel speed >= median wheel speed of wheel-running windows in the discovery part (0.309 turns/s)

features.name: wheel_onset
features.label: wheel-bout onset
features.definition: 0 to 0.5 s after a wheel bout starts

features.name: wheel_offset
features.label: wheel-bout offset
features.definition: 0 to 0.5 s after a wheel bout ends

features.name: patch_wheel_idle
features.label: at the patch, wheel idle
features.definition: patch distance <= 100 px and wheel speed <= 0.02 turns/s
features.population: windows with valid tracking and wheel samples

features.name: post_pellet
features.label: after a pellet trigger
features.definition: 0 to 2 s after a pellet trigger

features.name: pre_pellet
features.label: before a pellet trigger
features.definition: 0 to 1 s before a pellet trigger
